title: Ultrasonic Paint Brush Cleaner — Portable Deep Cleaning - US
description: The Ultrasonic Paint Brush Cleaner penetrates deep into the ferrule to dissolve dried acrylic that hand washing can't reach — bringing dead brushes back to life in minutes. Safe, simple, and built for miniature painters who want to stop throwing away expensive brushes and start keeping them sharp. One machine, endless uses across your entire painting workflow. Deep Cleaning — No Dead Zones, No Residue Acrylic paint dries hard and builds up in the ferrule where hand washing can't reach. That residue forces bristles apart, ruining the tip and killing your brush. Ultrasonic cavitation penetrates deep into the gap between bristles and metal — shaking loose cured acrylic that's been dried for days. Even brushes you thought were dead come back with sharp tips, ready to paint again. Optimized for Acrylics — Gentle on Brush Fiber Acrylic forms a tough, waterproof film once dried — water alone won't dissolve it. With a small amount of mild brush cleaner, the ultrasonic action accelerates emulsification and penetration. A few minutes of cleaning removes far more residue than scrubbing or soaking ever could — you can actually see the paint flushing out. Clean multiple brushes at once — no need to scrub each one by hand. Choose from 5 preset times (90, 180, 300, 480, or 600 seconds) to match the job — a quick rinse or a deep clean for stubborn residue. The digital display shows the countdown, and the machine shuts off automatically when done. While it runs, you can keep painting, mixing colors, or assembling models. Your hands stay free, and your brushes stay clean. Zero-Skill Operation — Safe for Beginners & Delicate Tips Just add water and a little brush cleaner, drop in your brushes, press start. That's it. Brushes suspend above the tank floor — no crushed tips, no damaged bristles. No special technique required.
